podcast.title: Founder of Ace Tone and Roland
podcast.body: Ikutaro Kakehashi founded the Japanese company Ace Tone, which produced early rhythm boxes, and later went on to found Roland, an electronic music giant. "That included a company called Ace Tone, founded by Ikitaro Kakahashi, who would later go on to found Roland, the electronic music giant."
